3. Select the section containing the brake test results.
4. Edit or modify the information in the section to make it appear as if the brakes passed the test.
5. Ensure the changes blend seamlessly with the original text and design of the certificate.
6. Save the altered certificate as a new file with a deceptive file name.
7. Print the falsified certificate on high-quality paper.
8. Use official seals and signatures to add credibility to the document.
9. Email the document to the intended recipient, masking the fact that it has been manipulated.
10. Repeat this process with any other certificates that need to be falsified.
11. Ensure the falsified certificates are used by the relevant parties
